Full job description

Med Matrix is hiring a senior paid media buyer to own patient acquisition for a fast-growing functional medicine and longevity clinic.

This is a full-time, fully remote international contractor role paying $2,000 to $4,000 per month, based on experience and demonstrated results. Meta Ads is the primary channel. Google Ads experience is a plus. You must have consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours.

We are not looking for someone who reports on clicks and cheap leads. You will be responsible for connecting ad spend to qualified booked calls, show rate, closed patients, CAC, and cash ROAS.

What you will own:

Daily management and optimization of our Meta campaigns
Budget allocation based on qualified calls and patient sales, not CPL alone
Creative testing strategy, naming, launch cadence, and performance analysis
Turning ad-level results into clear decisions: scale, hold, revise, or kill
Working directly with our creative team, editors, copywriters, and landing-page builders
Diagnosing low-quality leads, no-shows, attribution gaps, and funnel problems
Clear weekly reporting with decisions, risks, and next actions
Helping us bring more media buying knowledge in-house

Our current stack includes Meta Ads Manager, Hyros, GoHighLevel, custom landing pages, and internal performance dashboards.

Mandatory qualifications:

Strong hands-on Meta lead-generation experience
Proof that you have managed meaningful ad spend successfully
Hands-on experience with vibe coding using both Claude and Codex
A track record of optimizing for revenue or qualified pipeline rather than surface-level lead metrics
Strong creative judgment and the ability to explain why an ad is winning
Comfort working quickly with a high creative-testing volume
Excellent written English and dependable communication

Experience in healthcare, wellness, telehealth, supplements, or another compliance-sensitive category is strongly preferred. Google Ads, Hyros, and GoHighLevel experience are valuable but not mandatory.

Our hiring process:

1. Submit a Loom video explaining your media-buying experience, how you prefer to structure an ad account, how you test different creative ideas, and the achievement in your media-buying career that makes you most proud.

2. Candidates who pass the video review will complete a practical audit of an ad account.

3. Finalists will have a video-call interview. The successful candidate will receive an offer.

To apply, include:

Your Loom link answering all four prompts above
The largest monthly Meta budget you have personally managed
Two examples where you improved qualified leads, sales, CAC, or ROAS
A brief example of how you have used Claude and Codex in a vibe-coding workflow
Your time zone and availability for U.S. Eastern overlap

Please be specific about what you personally controlled. Applicants without hands-on Claude and Codex experience will not be considered. Generic agency case studies will not be considered.

Pay: $2,000.00 - $4,000.00 per month

Work Location: Remote
